organization_business_hours_times.name: organization_business_hours_times
organization_business_hours_times.value: ("organization_business_hours"."is_open" and "organization_business_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" > "organization_business_hours"."opens_at") or (not "organization_business_hours"."is_open" and "organization_business_hours"."opens_at" is null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" is null)

site_domains_lifecycle.name: site_domains_lifecycle
site_domains_lifecycle.value:
("site_domains"."status" = 'pending_verification' and "site_domains"."verified_at" is null and "site_domains"."activated_at" is null and "site_domains"."disabled_at" is null and "site_domains"."removed_at" is null)
        or ("site_domains"."status" = 'verified' and "site_domains"."verified_at" is not null and "site_domains"."activated_at" is null and "site_domains"."disabled_at" is null and "site_domains"."removed_at" is null)
        or ("site_domains"."status" = 'active' and "site_domains"."verified_at" is not null and "site_domains"."activated_at" is not null and "site_domains"."disabled_at" is null and "site_domains"."removed_at" is null)
        or ("site_domains"."status" = 'disabled' and "site_domains"."verified_at" is not null and "site_domains"."activated_at" is not null and "site_domains"."disabled_at" is not null and "site_domains"."removed_at" is null)
        or ("site_domains"."status" = 'removed' and "site_domains"."removed_at" is not null)

site_versions_number_shape.name: site_versions_number_shape
site_versions_number_shape.value: ("site_versions"."status" = 'draft') = ("site_versions"."version_number" is null) and ("site_versions"."version_number" is null or "site_versions"."version_number" >= 1)

customers_json_shapes.name: customers_json_shapes
customers_json_shapes.value: ("customers"."maintenance_plan" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."maintenance_plan") = 'object') and ("customers"."last_service" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."last_service") = 'object') and ("customers"."upcoming" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."upcoming") = 'object')

services_pricing_shape.name: services_pricing_shape
services_pricing_shape.value:
("services"."pricing_model" = 'free-assessment' and "services"."price_amount" is null and "services"."price_label" is null)
        or ("services"."pricing_model" = 'fixed-price' and coalesce("services"."price_amount" > 0, false) and "services"."price_label" is null)
        or ("services"."pricing_model" = 'diagnostic-fee' and coalesce("services"."price_amount" > 0, false) and coalesce(char_length(btrim("services"."price_label")) > 0, false))

bookings_submission_key.name: bookings_submission_key
bookings_submission_key.value: "bookings"."submission_key" is null or char_length("bookings"."submission_key") between 8 and 64

bookings_discovery_shape.name: bookings_discovery_shape
bookings_discovery_shape.value: ("bookings"."discovery_service" is null or ("bookings"."discovery_service" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' and char_length("bookings"."discovery_service") <= 80)) and ("bookings"."discovery_location" is null or ("bookings"."discovery_location" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' and char_length("bookings"."discovery_location") <= 80))

bookings_contact_without_customer.name: bookings_contact_without_customer
bookings_contact_without_customer.value: "bookings"."customer_id" is null or ("bookings"."contact_phone" is null and "bookings"."contact_email" is null and "bookings"."contact_address" is null)

bookings_property_needs_customer.name: bookings_property_needs_customer
bookings_property_needs_customer.value: "bookings"."property_id" is null or "bookings"."customer_id" is not null

job_files_category.name: job_files_category
job_files_category.value: "job_files"."category" is null or "job_files"."category" in ('Before work', 'Diagnostic / Meter', 'Equipment serial', 'After completion')

jobs_property_needs_customer.name: jobs_property_needs_customer
jobs_property_needs_customer.value: "jobs"."property_id" is null or "jobs"."customer_id" is not null

jobs_completion.name: jobs_completion
jobs_completion.value:
("jobs"."status" = 'completed' and "jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "jobs"."completion_notes" is not null)
        or ("jobs"."status" <> 'completed' and "jobs"."completed_at" is null and "jobs"."completion_notes" is null)

generated.as: issue_date + (case payment_terms when 'net-7' then 7 when 'net-15' then 15 when 'net-30' then 30 else 0 end)

invoices_property_needs_customer.name: invoices_property_needs_customer
invoices_property_needs_customer.value: "invoices"."property_id" is null or "invoices"."customer_id" is not null

payments_void.name: payments_void
payments_void.value:
("payments"."status" = 'voided' and "payments"."voided_at" is not null and "payments"."void_reason" is not null)
        or ("payments"."status" = 'recorded' and "payments"."voided_at" is null and "payments"."void_reason" is null and "payments"."void_note" is null and "payments"."voided_by" is null)

quotes_property_needs_customer.name: quotes_property_needs_customer
quotes_property_needs_customer.value: "quotes"."property_id" is null or "quotes"."customer_id" is not null

quotes_status_dates.name: quotes_status_dates
quotes_status_dates.value:
("quotes"."status" <> 'sent' or "quotes"."sent_on" is not null)
        and ("quotes"."status" <> 'approved' or ("quotes"."sent_on" is not null and "quotes"."approved_on" is not null))
        and ("quotes"."status" <> 'declined' or ("quotes"."sent_on" is not null and "quotes"."declined_on" is not null))
        and ("quotes"."status" <> 'expired' or ("quotes"."sent_on" is not null and "quotes"."expired_on" is not null))
        and ("quotes"."status" = 'approved' or "quotes"."approved_on" is null)
        and ("quotes"."status" = 'declined' or "quotes"."declined_on" is null)
        and ("quotes"."status" = 'expired' or "quotes"."expired_on" is null)
        and ("quotes"."status" <> 'draft' or "quotes"."sent_on" is null)

plan_visits_window.name: plan_visits_window
plan_visits_window.value: ("maintenance_plan_visits"."window_start" is null) = ("maintenance_plan_visits"."window_end" is null) and ("maintenance_plan_visits"."window_start" is null or "maintenance_plan_visits"."window_end" >= "maintenance_plan_visits"."window_start")

plans_term.name: plans_term
plans_term.value: "maintenance_plans"."start_date" is null or "maintenance_plans"."end_date" is null or "maintenance_plans"."end_date" > "maintenance_plans"."start_date"

plans_property_needs_customer.name: plans_property_needs_customer
plans_property_needs_customer.value: "maintenance_plans"."property_id" is null or "maintenance_plans"."customer_id" is not null

campaign_recipients_result.name: campaign_recipients_result
campaign_recipients_result.value: ("marketing_campaign_recipients"."status" = 'pending') = ("marketing_campaign_recipients"."delivered_at" is null) and ("marketing_campaign_recipients"."failure_reason" is null or "marketing_campaign_recipients"."status" = 'not-delivered')

campaigns_sent.name: campaigns_sent
campaigns_sent.value: ("marketing_campaigns"."status" = 'sent') = ("marketing_campaigns"."sent_on" is not null) and ("marketing_campaigns"."sent_at" is null or "marketing_campaigns"."status" = 'sent')

campaigns_delivery.name: campaigns_delivery
campaigns_delivery.value: ("marketing_campaigns"."delivered_count" is null) = ("marketing_campaigns"."not_delivered_count" is null) and ("marketing_campaigns"."delivered_count" is null or ("marketing_campaigns"."status" = 'sent' and "marketing_campaigns"."delivered_count" >= 0 and "marketing_campaigns"."not_delivered_count" >= 0 and "marketing_campaigns"."delivered_count" + "marketing_campaigns"."not_delivered_count" = "marketing_campaigns"."recipient_count"))

baselines_period.name: baselines_period
baselines_period.value: ("analytics_imported_baselines"."period_start" is null) = ("analytics_imported_baselines"."period_end" is null) and ("analytics_imported_baselines"."period_start" is null or "analytics_imported_baselines"."period_end" >= "analytics_imported_baselines"."period_start")

marketplace_service_areas_shape.name: marketplace_service_areas_shape
marketplace_service_areas_shape.value: ("marketplace_service_areas"."city" is not null and "marketplace_service_areas"."state_region" is not null and "marketplace_service_areas"."postal_code" is null) or ("marketplace_service_areas"."city" is null and "marketplace_service_areas"."state_region" is null and "marketplace_service_areas"."postal_code" is not null)

marketplace_service_areas_city.name: marketplace_service_areas_city
marketplace_service_areas_city.value: "marketplace_service_areas"."city" is null or ("marketplace_service_areas"."city" ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .''-]{1,59}$' and "marketplace_service_areas"."city" = btrim("marketplace_service_areas"."city") and "marketplace_service_areas"."city" !~ '[[:space:]]{2}')

marketplace_service_areas_label.name: marketplace_service_areas_label
marketplace_service_areas_label.value: "marketplace_service_areas"."label" is null or ("marketplace_service_areas"."label" = btrim("marketplace_service_areas"."label") and char_length("marketplace_service_areas"."label") between 1 and 60)

assets_dimensions.name: assets_dimensions
assets_dimensions.value: ("assets"."width" is null or "assets"."width" > 0) and ("assets"."height" is null or "assets"."height" > 0)

assets_original_filename.name: assets_original_filename
assets_original_filename.value: "assets"."original_filename" is null or char_length("assets"."original_filename") between 1 and 255

assets_lifecycle.name: assets_lifecycle
assets_lifecycle.value:
("assets"."status" = 'pending' and "assets"."ready_at" is null and "assets"."deleted_at" is null)
        or ("assets"."status" = 'failed' and "assets"."ready_at" is null and "assets"."deleted_at" is null)
        or ("assets"."status" = 'ready' and "assets"."ready_at" is not null and "assets"."deleted_at" is null)
        or ("assets"."status" = 'deleted' and "assets"."deleted_at" is not null)
